## Analysing data from one model

```{r}
library(survival)
library(survminer)
library(tidyverse)
library(JM)
```

### Read in data

First read in information about centres available for this model.

```{r}
# This is to analyse file xi-th, corresponding to myfile
xi <- 4 # later on for loop 1:4
alldata <- readxl::read_excel("./data/overview1.xlsx")
myfile <- alldata$FileName[xi]
mymodel <- strsplit(myfile, split = " ")[[1]][ 1 ]
all.sheets <- as.character(alldata[xi, -1])
names(all.sheets) <- colnames(alldata)[ -1 ] 
all.sheets <- all.sheets[ !is.na(all.sheets) ]
list.centers <- names(all.sheets)
```

The data here is for model `r mymodel`. It was analysed by the following centers:

```{r}
knitr::kable(list.centers, col.names = "Centers")
```

```{r eval = FALSE}
# If I work with separate variables
sh.nki <- all.sheets[ grep("NKI", all.sheets) ]
sh.vhio <- all.sheets[ grep("VHIO", all.sheets) ]
sh.rug <- all.sheets[ grep("RUG", all.sheets) ]
sh.unito <- all.sheets[ grep("UNITO", all.sheets) ]
sh.ic <- all.sheets[ grep("IC", all.sheets) ]
sh.leuven <- all.sheets[ grep("KULEUVEN", all.sheets) ]
sh.ucam <- all.sheets[ grep("UCAM", all.sheets) ]
sh.oslo <- all.sheets[ grep("Oslo", all.sheets) ]

```




```{r echo = FALSE, eval = FALSE}
mymodel # name of the model

all.sheets # names of the sheets to be used
list.centers # names of the centers available
```

#### Analysis per center

```{r}
n_center <- length(list.centers)

## For now the first argument of lapply is 1, becuase of inconsistency of the data, after having consistent data it will be equal to 1:n_centers

data_centers <- lapply(list(1),
function(x){
   tb= readxl::read_excel(paste("data/", myfile, sep = ""), 
                          col_names=TRUE, sheet = all.sheets[x])%>%
         filter(Label != "Waste") %>%
         select(-Label, -`Start Info`, -`End Info`, - date)%>%
         select(
            where(
             ~!all(is.na(.x))
                 )
                )  
  return(tb)}
  )

``` 
VHIO = data_centers[[1]]

VHIO$Group[1]

VHIO$Treatment
VHIO$`event /status`
# the event for each mouse should be specified. I just put one for the first mouse, to include this column in the tibble. 

VHIO_long <- VHIO %>%
gather(key= "time", value="tumor size", -`Genealogy ID`, -Barcode, -Group,  -Treatment, -`follow up time`, -`event /status`) %>%
  arrange(`Genealogy ID`)




VHIO_long$time <- as.numeric(VHIO_long$time) - as.numeric(VHIO_long$time[1])



VHIO_long <- VHIO_long%>%
  mutate(`tumor size`=as.numeric(`tumor size`)) %>%
  mutate(time = as.numeric(time))%>%
  filter(`tumor size` !=-1)

range(VHIO_long$`tumor size`)
```
